title: Dave Girouard - Making Better Loans - [Founder’s Field Guide, EP. 52]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Dave Girouard, co-founder and CEO of Upstart.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Dave Girouard, co-founder and CEO of Upstart, a lending platform that leverages AI to make loans more accessible and affordable. Dave started in Silicon Valley as a Product Manager at Apple and later spent eight years at Google, where he built their suite of cloud apps. In our discussion, we cover the lessons Dave has learned about building speed into a habit.

key_points.text: In our discussion, we cover the lessons Dave has learned about building speed into a habit.
We also discuss the past, present, and future of lending.
One of the tropes you hear these days is that lending has become a customer acquisition tool for FinTechs, but as Dave explains.
